articles.title: Alleged Kimwolf Botmaster ‘Dort’ Arrested, Charged in U.S. and Canada
articles.summary: CISA—the agency that's supposed to protect everyone else's cyber infrastructure—had a contractor casually dropping AWS GovCloud keys on GitHub like breadcrumbs. Congress is rightfully losing their minds over this spectacular own-goal.

articles.title: Patch Tuesday, May 2026 Edition
articles.summary: A CISA contractor turned GitHub into their personal secrets dumping ground, exposing privileged AWS GovCloud credentials and internal systems to anyone with an internet connection. Peak cybersecurity agency irony achieved.

articles.title: Threat Actors Exploit Critical FortiClient EMS Flaw to Deploy Credential Stealer
articles.summary: Critical RCE in Gogs Git service scores 9.4 on CVSS—any authenticated user can execute arbitrary code. Self-hosted Git repos just became self-pwned repos.

articles.title: Microsoft Slams Public Zero-Day Disclosures Amid GitHub Researcher Account Removal
articles.summary: Threat actors are having a field day with that critical FortiClient EMS flaw, turning endpoint management infrastructure into credential-stealing malware delivery systems. Fortinet's security solutions securing nobody but the attackers.

articles.title: ThreatsDay Bulletin: Claude Security Plugin, Azure Priv-Esc, Kali365 MFA Bypass, FIFA Scams +15 More
articles.summary: Microsoft throws a tantrum about public zero-day disclosures after GitHub nuked a researcher's account, desperately pleading for 'coordinated disclosure' while probably sitting on unfixed vulns. The audacity is breathtaking.

articles.title: More License Plate Reader Mission Creep: School Residency Verification, Background Checks, and Noise Complaints
articles.summary: Age verification laws are creating a surveillance hellscape for everyone in the name of 'protecting children.' EFF breaks down how lawmakers are speedrunning the destruction of web privacy and accessibility.

articles.title: 🔒 A Win for Encrypted Messaging | EFFector 38.10
articles.summary: License plate readers have gone full mission creep—cops are now using ALPR databases for school residency checks and noise complaints without warrants. Automated surveillance state, one parking violation at a time.

articles.title: Microsoft Took a Step Toward Human Rights Accountability. Google and Amazon (and Others) Should Pay Attention!
articles.summary: EFF celebrates a rare victory for end-to-end encryption, the one thing standing between our private conversations and the surveillance apparatus. Actual good news in the digital rights wasteland.

articles.title: Tucker Carlson Doles Out Some Truly Strange Credit Card Advice
articles.summary: Student hacker claims they breached India's CBSE exam evaluation system while the board insists it was just a 'testing platform.' Classic 'it's not a breach if we call it something else' defense strategy.

articles.title: TrendAI™ is recognized as a Leader in the 2026 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Endpoint Protection Platforms
articles.summary: New research shows multi-agent LLM systems can automate vulnerability discovery and reproduction, potentially finding some of those 50,000 CVEs faster than humans. AI finally doing something useful for security instead of just hallucinating threats.
